name: signal_firpm
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox firpm — Parks-McClellan optimal equiripple FIR via Remez exchange. Supports Type I (even N) and Type II (odd N). Type II uses the Q-transformation D'(ω) = D / cos(ω/2), W'(ω) = W · cos(ω/2), then reconstructs h via half-integer-shifted cosine coeffs b[n] = (a[n] + a[n+1])/2 (special-cased at endpoints). Algorithm details: dense grid 16·(L+2) points proportional to band widths; band-aware initial extremals (≥2 per band, equispaced); each iteration solves Lagrange δ formula, builds barycentric polynomial through L+1 of the L+2 extremals, evaluates error on grid, multiple-exchange to update extremals. Approximate-equal MATLAB R2025b (~5 sig figs) on eight probed designs covering LP / BP / HP / weighted / multi-band Type-I plus Type-II LP (n=21 and n=31). KNOWN GAPS: 'hilbert' / 'differentiator' ftypes (Type III / IV — different sin-based Q-factor), fresp function-handle form, 3rd `res` output struct, lgrid cell-form. Octave 11.1.0 ships firpm in the signal package (not core).
